summary: Skillsoft Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of the sale of its Global Knowledge Training LLC (instructor-led training business) to EHJob GP LLC (affiliate of Enduring Ventures). The total consideration is ~$5.4M initial (funded by a seller note due July 31, 2026, with $2M extendable to Oct 31, 2026) plus deferred consideration of $10M less ~$2M for employee liabilities, payable in five quarterly installments starting nine months post-close. The deferred payment is guaranteed by the company and secured by the transferred companies' IP. A 30% earn-out applies on any sale of the transferred companies within three years. No premium, board recommendation, or advisor is named. Watch for working-capital adjustments and the collectability of deferred payments; risk-arb focuses on the secured note and earn-out mechanics.
